venues.name: Atatürk Kültür ve Sanat Merkezi
aliases: Anadolu Üniversitesi Atatürk Kültür ve Sanat Merkezi
venues.evidence: OSM name tag matches; handoff centre 39.791214/30.499968 is the mean of this way's nodes (0.1 m). Official AKM page lists its four halls.

venues.name: Öğrenci Merkezi
aliases: Öğrenci Merkezi Yunus Emre Salonu ve Fuaye Alanı
Öğrenci Merkezi Nasrettin Hoca Salonu ve Fuaye Alanı
venues.evidence: OSM name tag matches; handoff centre is the mean of this way's nodes. Official pages place Yunus Emre Salonu (368) and Nasrettin Hoca Salonu / Salon 2009 (265) in this building.

venues.name: Kütüphane ve Dokümantasyon Merkezi
venues.evidence: OSM name tag "Kütüphane"; handoff centre is the mean of this way's nodes.

venues.name: Sinema Anadolu
venues.evidence: OSM name tag matches; handoff centre is the mean of this way's nodes. Official page: 395 seats. The event feed also names the open-air stand area in front of the building ("Sinema Anadolu Sokak"), which is no building of its own, so those events land on the cinema.

venues.name: Çağdaş Sanatlar Müzesi
venues.evidence: OSM name tag matches. Official museum page: single-storey, rectangular, yellow-white facade, formerly a barracks building.

venues.name: Eskişehir Meslek Yüksekokulu
venues.evidence: OSM name tag "Eskişehir Meslek Yüksek Okulu", building:levels=2; handoff centre is the mean of this way's nodes.

venues.name: Bilişim Teknolojileri Meslek Yüksekokulu
aliases: Bilişim Teknolojileri Meslek Yüksekokulu Konferans Salonu
venues.evidence: OSM way/667918876 "Bilişim Bloğu" (building=school, building:levels=4, addr:street Anadolu Üniversitesi) is the information-technology block. The university event feed names the hall inside it "Bilişim Teknolojileri Meslek Yüksekokulu Konferans Salonu", so that name maps here; the plan carries no verified number for the block.

venues.name: Turizm Fakültesi
venues.evidence: OSM name tag matches; handoff centre is the mean of this way's nodes.

venues.name: Hukuk Fakültesi
venues.evidence: OpenStreetMap labels this footprint "Yabancı Diller Yüksekokulu-2", which is a wrong label rather than a second building: the OSM node node/11450099269 inside the block is named "Anadolu Üniversitesi Hukuk Fakültesi" (amenity=school, operator "Anadolu Üniversitesi Hukuk Fakültesi Dekanlığı ve Rektörlüğü") and the official plan's number 27 falls 29 m from the same footprint. The map follows the node and the plan.

venues.name: Eğitim Fakültesi
venues.evidence: OSM multipolygon relation "Eğitim Fakültesi A - B - C Blok" (university, addr:street Anadolu Üniversitesi) is 15 m from the official plan's number 22 marker; official plan lists number 22 as Eğitim Fakültesi A–E Blok.

venues.name: Eczacılık Fakültesi
venues.evidence: OSM multipolygon relation "Eczacılık Fakültesi" is inside the campus boundary; the official plan numbers 18 and 19 (faculty and its lounge) sit in the same western block and the Tepebaşı–Eczacılık gate is named after it.

venues.name: Kongre Merkezi
venues.evidence: The official plan draws numbers 38 (Kongre Merkezi) and 45 (Anadolu Konukevi) on the same block, the plan marker for 38 falls 22 m from this footprint's centre, and the Lisansüstü Eğitim Enstitüsü gives its official address as "Kongre Merkezi Binası, Yunus Emre Kampüsü" (https://www.anadolu.edu.tr/akademik/enstituler/2113/lisansustu-egitim-enstitusu/iletisim-bilgileri). OpenStreetMap labels the outline "Otel Anadolu" (tourism=hotel) after the guesthouse the block also houses, so the name tag alone was misleading; the plan and the university address place the congress centre here. Official page: Salon Anadolu 251, Kırmızı 130, Mavi 88.

venues.name: Salon 2003 (Koral Çalgan Salonu)
venues.evidence: Salon 2003 is the same hall as Koral Çalgan Salonu (renamed in October 2019, e-Gazete). The plan puts number 53 at [-188, 314], north of Teknopark, where OSM has only unnamed small buildings; the nearest named block is relation/5563046 ("Yunus Emre Sağlık Hizmetleri Meslek Yüksekokulu"), but that wing could not be verified as the hall, so no pin is drawn.

venues.name: Yeni Yemekhane
aliases: Yeni Yemekhane ve Sinema Anadolu Önü
venues.evidence: OSM name tag "Anadolu Üniversitesi Yeni Yemekhane".

venues.name: Anadolu Üniversitesi Camii
venues.evidence: OSM building=mosque inside campus; no name tag, so the name is the university's own and the footprint is the evidence.

venues.name: KYK ve Bankamatikler Önü
venues.evidence: The square in front of the KYK dormitories, where the campus ATMs stand (Ziraat Bankası ATM node/10052862752, 39.7912163/30.5027838). The official plan numbers 11 (ATM gişeleri) and 39 (KYK yurtları): the ATMs are the venue and the dormitory block way/374982346 ("KYK Öğrenci Yurtları", building=dormitory) is its anchor, so the footprint is drawn.
